description: This Java class, SignalEnrichmentCacheLoader, implements an asynchronous cache loader for partial 'things' using a SignalEnrichmentFacade. It retrieves partial JSON objects based on cache lookup context and JSON field selectors, facilitating lazy loading and cache population.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentCacheLoader
classes.description: A cache loader class that asynchronously loads partial 'things' as JsonObjects, utilizing a SignalEnrichmentFacade and cache lookup contexts.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate SignalEnrichmentCacheLoader with a given SignalEnrichmentFacade.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Implements the loading logic, retrieving partial data asynchronously if cache lookup context and JSON field selector are present; otherwise returns an empty JsonObject wrapped in a CompletableFuture.
